issues.explanation: The light gray navigation labels lack sufficient color contrast against the off-white header background, rendering main menu items hard to read.
issues.location_in_image: Top navigation links (SHOP, COLLECTIONS, ABOUT, CONTACT)
issues.suggested_fix: Darken the navigation text color to a deeper shade of brown or dark gray to achieve at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

issues.explanation: The light gray body paragraph text fails the 4.5:1 accessibility contrast threshold against the light background, causing legibility issues for secondary descriptive content.
issues.location_in_image: Body description text below the main headline
issues.suggested_fix: Increase text darkness to a dark charcoal or dark brown color to ensure readable contrast against the background.

issues.explanation: The pastel orange eyebrow text on the light cream background does not meet minimum contrast standards, impairing the readability of the category tag.
issues.suggested_fix: Use a darker amber or warm brown shade for the eyebrow text to meet the 4.5:1 contrast requirement.

issues.explanation: The white digit inside the small orange shopping cart badge has poor contrast against the light orange badge fill, making the item count difficult to see.
issues.location_in_image: Cart badge digit '0' in the top right header
issues.suggested_fix: Darken the badge background color or change the text color inside the badge to a dark color to improve contrast.
